Paragraph with br tags produces line breaks in output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Line one.<br>Line two.<br>Line three.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
